title: Thread memory and durable SQLite checkpoints
limitations: Supplementary update after L08, not an original source-video SQLite lesson; contextual L08 interval is 01:42:54–02:03:20.
Agent validation uses explicit offline model doubles, not real Anthropic or tracing requests; parent must validate both --live entry points.
Demonstration makes four real model calls; independent solution makes five. Generated prose varies; acceptance checks supplied facts and structural state.
Demonstration validates closed/reopened connections and a fresh-interpreter checkpoint read; solution validates closed/reopened connections and matching recovered checkpoint IDs.
Graceful recovery only: no operating-system reboot, forced termination, power-loss recovery, backup restoration, or schema migration validation.
Logical thread isolation is not authorization, encryption, or a privacy boundary for someone with database access.
Local synchronous SQLite is for lightweight use; concurrent multi-worker production deployment is outside scope.
No bounded-history or checkpoint-retention policy is implemented; model input and stored history grow.
Screenshots, diagram rendering, Windows checks, integration, and publication are parent-owned and not claimed here.
